readout_other: whole-cell patch clamp: network firing, mEPSC, mIPSC, tonic GABA current; pharmacology (bicuculline, gabazine, AITC, HC-030031)
direction_notes: Single-shot PW or CW had no effect; repetitive PW (20 repetitions) persistently reduced spontaneous network firing via astrocytes and TRPA1-dependent increase in tonic GABA current; repetitive CW had no effect.

exposures.label: Cultured hippocampal neurons on astrocytes, 5 MHz PW and CW

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed wave: 0.5-ms tone burst, PRF 100 Hz, DC 5%, 2 s per sonication; continuous wave: 100 ms. Single-shot (2-s PW applied five times at 20-s intervals) versus repetitive (PW repeated 20 times at 10-s intervals, total approx. 192 s; 10 repetitions also tested).

flags.reason: Paper gives 19.2 mW/cm2; recorded as 0.0192 W/cm2 (unit conversion only).
0.38 W/cm2 is for the PW pattern and 0.7 W/cm2 for the CW pattern (quoted separately in the text); only the PW sentence is quoted here.
Paper says all stimulation was at 100 kPa (maximum measured 150 kPa); the transducer was calibrated in degassed water but the paper does not label the 100 kPa value as free-field.
Group sizes are numbers of independent experiments (PW x10 n=9, PW x20 n=19, control n=25 unstimulated); no total of cultures or animals is stated.
List is [PW 2 s, CW 100 ms]; the repetitive protocol totals about 192 s (see protocol_description).
